findings.reason: a node implementing "q95 relative difference against SELENE" would either blockade on a value PSRC never carries, or silently source it elsewhere, and the section's own decision already establishes that SELENE q exists for one shot only.
findings.text: §7 states that "q95 and Ip ... are reported per shot in the stamped record as relative differences against SELENE", but the frozen benchmark set is the sixteen 2023 OP1 shots and the plan's own decision jt60sa-psi-q-source (§7 lines 265-266 and the decision at lines 892-902) records that SELENE's PSRC category carries no q profile and that E101011's G-EQDSK is the single q reference — so fourteen-plus of the sixteen shots have no SELENE q95 to subtract. The plan needs to name the q95 reference it actually means (the EDDB FAME scalars, which §6 already uses for q-handedness, or None where absent), exactly as it does for the boundary, axis and Ip references.
